releaseNotes.summary: Juno Beta 0.3 Hotfix 3 repairs signed update discovery in the installed Windows application, so Juno finds its bundled update-trust configuration without an environment override.
highlights: The packaged updater now resolves resources/update-trust.json from the application's own resources directory instead of the process working directory.
A normally installed Juno reports a configured signed update channel, fetches the HTTPS manifest and verifies its Ed25519 signature with the bundled pinned key.
Update installation stays manual: Juno announces a signed release and opens the release page; it never downloads or runs the unsigned installer.
improvements: A focused regression test starts the packaged updater with no override and fails if the trust lookup falls back to the source checkout.
fixes: Fixed installed builds reporting 'Automatic updates are not configured in this build' even though resources/update-trust.json shipped beside the app.
Fixed rc.18, rc.19 and rc.20 requiring JUNO_UPDATE_TRUST_FILE before they could discover the signed feed.
knownIssues: Users of rc.18, rc.19 and rc.20 must install rc.21 by hand once, because those builds cannot discover the feed by default.
The Windows installer remains unsigned; automatic installation of unsigned updates is intentionally disabled.
The NSIS installer itself is not executed on this development host to protect the owner's existing Beta installation.
releaseNotes.compatibility: Windows x64. Existing Beta profiles upgrade in place and keep their data, bots and conversations unless the owner explicitly chooses Reset Juno.
